questions.q: Which critical raw materials do hydrogen electrolysers depend on, according to the EU's own analysis?
questions.judge: Cites the EU Joint Research Centre deep dive on critical raw materials for hydrogen technologies (2026) from the library and names materials such as platinum-group metals (iridium, platinum), nickel or rare earths. Notes or allows that the text was OCR-extracted if quoting exact numbers. Fail if it does not use the JRC report.

questions.q: What does the Queensland Critical Minerals Prospectus say about the North West Minerals Province?
questions.judge: Uses the Queensland Critical Minerals Prospectus 2026-27 from the library, describes the North West Minerals Province (around Mount Isa / Cloncurry) as presented there, and credits the State of Queensland. Fail if it relies only on general knowledge or the web.
